Interviewer: This intake belongs only to the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: Olli Fable is my name; Tera Fable is my spouse.
Caller: We married on 2012-12-01.
Caller: I live at 44 Demonstration Terrace Demo Borough.
Caller: Our child is Avi Fable born 2016-01-25.
Caller: We separated on 2024-06-17.
Interviewer: What is your holiday proposal?
Caller: Split the winter school break equally, with the first half at Olli Fable's home.
Caller: Tera has not agreed to that, and I am not proposing anything for other holidays.
Caller: Dissolve our marriage.
